plan.objective: Test whether the reference/target face-scale mismatch can be corrected after the encoder in feature space.
plan.hypothesis: Post-encoder ROI warping recovers registration without changing reference pixels.
plan.single_scientific_change: model.ba_hard_v1_reference_roi_warp=true with the native 256px reference (existing defaults-off flag, pinned false for E1-E24)
plan.fixed_contract: 24k steps, batch 2, one A100, fixed full96 at step 0 and every 2k, shadow pretrained-default validation, hard spatial BA r128 + generic r32 + PhotoMaker-default r64 at 1e-4, masked_loss_step=1, pose_adapt_ratio=0, ca_mixing_for_face=false, 2240 tensors / 219,217,920 parameters
plan.shared_cosmic_controls: min_face_res=192, pose-first captions capped at 50 words, target mirroring on, reference mirroring OFF, no self-reference fallback

decision_gates.step_8000: ID >= .30212 (E13 step 0); below and falling => stop, record negative
decision_gates.step_12000: ID >= .32704 (E11 best clean arm) to continue to 24k
decision_gates.step_24000: ID within .02 of E13 .39980 AND clean full-96 face anatomy

plan.prerequisite: none; contingency arm, run only if CL2 is clearly positive but incomplete
plan.step_zero_expectation: CHANGES the step-zero route (like E1/E3/E4/E12); declare its own step-zero value

preflight.note: CL3 deliberately preserves the uncorrected pixel-space mismatch; the measured median 2.157 confirms the analysis prediction of 2.12 from population medians.

plan.caption_cap_note: prompt_max_words lowered 55 -> 50 after a real-data measurement: at 55 16.5% of Cosmic captions still exceeded 77 CLIP tokens. A 3000-record sweep showed pose-first ordering alone leaves 87.2% over (legacy 86.4%), so the cap, not the ordering, controls truncation. Cap 50 gives 0.7%.

roi_warp_verification.method: direct CPU test of _warp_reference_roi_to_target with measured Cosmic geometry
roi_warp_verification.note: Sink normalization comes from `warped * target_mask_2d` at attn_processor_cleanest.py:574, not from the face_key_mask_flat switch, which is inert while ba_hard_v1_true_reference_key_mask is false.
